server.description: SQL Server hostname, IP address, or named instance (e.g. SQLSERVER01 or 192.168.1.10\SQLEXPRESS)

port.description: TCP port for the SQL Server connection

database.description: Name of the target SQL Server database

schema.description: Schema in which Bifrost creates its own tables (e.g. Bifrost_audit_log). Must be a valid SQL identifier. Defaults to 'dbo'. The schema is created automatically on first connection if it does not exist and the account has CREATE SCHEMA permission.

auth_type.description: Authentication method: only Windows Authentication is supported; uses the current Windows session (Trusted_Connection=yes).
